title: Length of the Tseitin Clause Terms
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $L$ and $A$ be lists of literals on $n$ coordinates. Suppose the coordinates of the literals in each list are pairwise distinct, and the two lists use disjoint sets of coordinates. The number of terms obtained from their Tseitin clause chain equals the number of clauses in that chain.
